reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.empty: Nobody has asked for reminders yet.

actions.newRateNote: The rate applies to sales from the date on; earlier bills keep theirs.
actions.resetPasswordNote: They are signed out everywhere and sign in with this password.
actions.packsNote: Each pack is its own SKU with its own price and stock. The cheapest active pack is the default.
actions.gradesNote: Qualities a pack can be, such as साधारण and विशेष.
actions.pairingsNote: Shown on the product page and as cart suggestions.
actions.recordMovementNote: Purchases, returns and damage are counted as given; an adjustment can be negative.
actions.kitFromPujaNote: Fills a kit with each samagri the puja lists, at its default pack. Samagri the shop does not sell are skipped.
actions.itemsNote: The packs in the kit and how many of each. Optional ones are left out unless the shopper adds them.
actions.samagriListNote: What this puja needs, how much and how strictly. Editing a line sends it back to unverified.
actions.verifyNote: Reviewed means checked by staff against a source; verified means confirmed by a guru or pandit.
actions.datesNote: One entry per year: lunar dates are entered here, never worked out.
actions.festivalPujasNote: The pujas the festival page offers, with their kits.
actions.publishNote: Only published articles show on the website; the first publish sets its date.

media.pickNote: Pick an uploaded image, or upload new ones (JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB).
media.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# image uploaded} other {# images uploaded}}
media.empty: No images yet. Upload the first one.
media.altText: What the image shows, for screen readers and search
media.libraryNote: Every uploaded image. Product, puja and pandit forms pick from here too.

orderActions.statusNote: Only the next steps the order can take are offered. A note goes into its history.
orderActions.receiveNote: The amount starts at what is still due. The bill is issued once the order is fully paid.
orderActions.qrMissing: There is nothing to pay, or the shop has no QR set up in its business profile.
orderActions.billNote: Add the buyer's PAN for a business bill.
orderActions.voidNote: It stays on record, struck through, with the reason.

bills.voidNote: A voided bill stays on record; issue a new one if needed.
bills.popup: Allow pop-ups for this site to print.

counterSale.reasonNeeded: Say why the discount is given
counterSale.afterNote: The sale opens as an order, where payment is taken and the bill issued.

customerActions.summary: {orders, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} · paid {paid} · due {due}

listPhotos.fillNote: Read the photos and write each line: what the customer wrote, the pack we sell for it, and how many. Leave the pack empty for something we do not sell.
